activities.name: Sunrise hot-air balloon safari
activities.listing_summary: A pre-dawn transfer, sunrise flight above the Maasai Mara and a landing-side breakfast make this a special but early start; confirm camp pickup, conservancy or park charges and weather arrangements.
activities.detail_intro: A balloon flight changes the scale of a Mara morning: river bends, open grassland and the moving pattern of wildlife become a broad landscape rather than a sequence of vehicle sightings. The experience is brief compared with a full game drive, so plan it as one part of a safari day, not a replacement for time on the ground.
activities.full_description:
Before sunrise, the camp vehicle heads to the launch area while the balloon crew prepares for flight. At dawn, the basket lifts over the Maasai Mara; the route and wildlife sightings depend on wind, visibility and where animals are that morning. After landing, the GetYourGuide hot-air balloon option includes a bush breakfast. You then return to your safari vehicle or camp and can continue with a game drive.

How to shape the day

Keep the evening before unhurried and arrange an early night. Confirm the pickup point and time with the operator, then leave the camp before dawn for the launch site and safety briefing. The flight takes place around sunrise; after landing and breakfast, return to your guide for a later drive, or plan a quieter rest period if the early start has taken its toll. A balloon is a good addition for a wide landscape perspective, while a vehicle remains better for close, ground-level observation and flexible stops.

Access and what to confirm

The GetYourGuide option is operated by Perfect Wilderness Tours and Safari and includes a bush breakfast. Its transfer depends on your camp’s location: confirm in writing that your accommodation is inside the pickup area, where you will meet, and how you rejoin your safari vehicle. Ask whether the price includes park or conservancy entry, taxes, breakfast, and transfers; do not assume the balloon booking covers your whole safari day. Balloon departures depend on weather and operational decisions, so establish the cancellation, postponement and refund policy before paying.

Who will enjoy it

This suits travelers comfortable with an early start, a shared basket and several hours of logistics around a relatively short flight. It may be a poor fit for anyone uneasy with heights or unable to board and stand in the basket; ask the operator about mobility and passenger requirements before booking. Families should check age and height rules directly. If your safari has only one full day, weigh the flight against the game-drive time you would give up.

What recent guests say

On GetYourGuide, Jacqui from the United Kingdom wrote in July 2024 that the sunrise flight was memorable even though she saw relatively few animals. That is a useful expectation: the aerial experience does not guarantee wildlife sightings.

Pack for the launch

  • Warm layers for a cool pre-dawn transfer, which you can remove as the day warms.
  • Closed, comfortable shoes for uneven ground around launch and landing sites.
  • A camera with a wrist or neck strap, and binoculars secured safely; follow crew directions about equipment in the basket.
  • Sun protection and drinking water for the later drive, plus any personal medication you need.

Keep voices low around wildlife, listen to the pilot and ground crew, and never ask a guide to approach an animal for a photograph. Treat the balloon as a way to observe the ecosystem, not a guarantee of a particular sighting or migration scene.

For context on ground-based viewing and park planning, continue with our Maasai Mara guide.
activities.best_time: The balloon operator says flights can operate year-round, subject to weather and daily conditions. The migration is not a dependable timetable for a particular flight or wildlife sighting. Choose dates around the wider safari you want, then verify the actual departure with the operator.
activities.practical_info: The GetYourGuide option is operated by Perfect Wilderness Tours and Safari. Confirm your exact camp pickup, launch area, park or conservancy fees, age and mobility rules, total duration, weather cancellation terms and return arrangements directly. Flight operation is weather dependent. Coordinate with your vehicle guide if you want to continue game viewing afterward.

activities.name: Guided wildlife game drives
activities.listing_summary: A long Nairobi-to-Amboseli day tour pairs a guided park drive with Maasai cultural content; confirm drive time, entry fees, pickup and optional village visits before choosing it over an overnight stay.
activities.detail_intro: Amboseli’s game drives move between open plains, acacia scrub and wetland edges, with Mount Kilimanjaro often framing the wider landscape when conditions allow. The listed excursion starts in Nairobi, making travel time a central part of the experience and an overnight base a more relaxed alternative for many travelers.
activities.full_description:
The attraction of an Amboseli drive is the changing habitat: dry ground gives way to marsh and swamp, while elephant herds and other wildlife use different parts of the ecosystem. Kenya Wildlife Service describes the park’s mix of grass plains, woodland, thorn scrub and wetlands, and highlights elephant viewing and birdlife. Kilimanjaro is a striking backdrop when visible, but cloud and haze can obscure it; no drive can promise a clear mountain view or a particular animal.

A realistic day from Nairobi

The GetYourGuide day tour starts in Nairobi rather than inside the park. Expect a very early departure, a substantial road journey each way, park formalities and a guided drive within the time remaining. Confirm the departure and return estimates with the operator and consider whether the schedule leaves enough time in the park for your priorities. If you can stay near Amboseli, arrive the previous day and use a full morning and afternoon drive instead of spending so much of the day in transit.

On arrival, agree with your guide how to use the drive: allow time around a sighting, keep moving when animals need space, and include a pause at a permitted viewpoint if the route and timing allow. KWS identifies Observation Hill as a park feature, but access and schedule depend on current rules and the tour plan. Ask which gates, route and game-drive vehicle are used.

Read the inclusions carefully

Niroskos Tours And Safaris operates the Nairobi day tour. Confirm park admission, vehicle upgrades and any optional Maasai village charges separately. Obtain a written breakdown of transport, guide, meals, park entry, taxes and any cultural visit. A village visit should be a separately explained, locally hosted activity; ask who receives the fee and follow residents’ guidance about photography and participation.

Suitability and responsible viewing

This format can suit travelers with limited time who accept a long day and road travel. It is less suitable for people who find prolonged vehicle time difficult, or anyone hoping for extended wildlife observation. KWS instructs visitors to stay on established roads, remain in vehicles except at designated places, observe speed and animal-distance rules, and keep noise low. Ask your driver to respect these rules even when a sighting attracts several vehicles.

What recent guests say

GetYourGuide reviewer Dylan (United Kingdom, 12 October 2026) praised the guide and wildlife sightings but described a long day and found the lunch options disappointing. That matches the main trade-off: substantial time on the road, with meal inclusions worth checking before departure.

Bring for the road and park

  • Binoculars and a camera strap for viewing from the vehicle.
  • Sun hat, sunscreen and a light layer for the early start.
  • Water, any needed medication and a small snack if meals are not confirmed.
  • Soft-sided day bag and modest clothing if the itinerary includes a community visit.

Carry out your rubbish and avoid single-use plastic in the park. Check the current KWS entry system and fee category for each traveler shortly before departure; rates and payment procedures can change.

For park access and landscape context, read the Amboseli National Park guide.
activities.best_time: Game drives operate across the year, while visibility, road conditions and wildlife distribution vary with rainfall and local conditions. KWS describes a mosaic of wetland and dry habitats rather than a single viewing circuit. Ask your lodge or operator what current conditions mean for the planned route; do not treat a seasonal wildlife expectation as a guaranteed sighting.
activities.practical_info: The GetYourGuide tour departs Nairobi and makes for a long road day. Confirm total driving and park time, exact pickup, park entry, vehicle type or upgrade, meals, guide, optional community-visit charges and cancellation terms. KWS lists access via Iremito, Kimana and Meshanani gates, and a Kimana airstrip for light aircraft; these are general access options, not proof of this tour’s route. Verify current park fees and gate rules with KWS.

activities.name: Serengeti balloon safari at dawn
activities.listing_summary: A pre-dawn transfer leads to a roughly one-hour sunrise flight and bush breakfast; launch region, lodge pickup, park entry and weather arrangements must be confirmed for your itinerary.
activities.detail_intro: From above, the Serengeti reads as a connected landscape of river lines, kopjes and open plains. A balloon flight offers that broad view at sunrise, then returns you to a ground safari; the aircraft follows the morning’s conditions, so wildlife and route are never guaranteed.
activities.full_description:
Serengeti Balloon Safaris operates this dawn flight. The operator describes a complete outing of about five hours, beginning with a pre-dawn pickup and transfer to the launch site, followed by a safety briefing, flight, landing toast, bush breakfast and return to your safari guide. Its actual launch region matters: Seronera, Ndutu and the northern Serengeti are far apart, so the correct product depends on where you will be staying on that date.

Plan around the launch area

Ask the operator to confirm your camp’s pickup and the named launch region before booking. Plan the preceding night close enough for the transfer and tell your vehicle guide when and where you expect to rejoin. After breakfast, you can continue a ground drive if the timing works; a flight does not replace the flexible, close observation offered by a vehicle. Leave the rest of the morning lightly scheduled in case pickup, weather or landing logistics change.

Season and wildlife expectations

Serengeti Balloon Safaris publishes launch reports from several regions, demonstrating that the balloon operation is not tied to one migration corridor. The migration moves and weather changes. Pick a region and dates based on the wider safari itinerary rather than an online prediction that herds will be under the basket. Flights are weather dependent; ask how cancellation, postponement and refunds are handled.

Who should book

This is a premium, early-start experience suited to travelers who value aerial perspective and are comfortable sharing a basket. The operator’s FAQ states a minimum flying age of six and says passengers need reasonable mobility; verify current passenger requirements, weight policies and accommodations directly. Travelers with limited safari time may prefer another full morning drive, and anyone uneasy with heights should consider that trade-off honestly.

Inclusions and packing

The operator says the flight package includes collection near a launch site, breakfast and return to a safari guide or agreed location. Park entry fees are not included in its published FAQ; determine whether these are already covered elsewhere in your safari package to avoid assumptions. Confirm the total price, taxes, flight duration and pickup details directly because offers and rates can change.

  • Warm layers for the dark, cool transfer and a hat for after sunrise.
  • Closed footwear and a camera strap; follow crew instructions about devices and loose items.
  • Binoculars if practical, plus sun protection and water for the later drive.

Listen to the pilot and crew, keep the launch area clear, and avoid asking the pilot to pursue wildlife. The operator describes dismantling temporary launch infrastructure after departures; low-impact conduct includes respecting staff instructions and leaving no litter.

Explore the broader Serengeti National Park guide before choosing a camp and flight zone.

What guests have reported

In an April 2025 verified GetYourGuide review, Liem from the United States described a smooth flight and breakfast, while noting that the experience felt expensive. The review is older and individual; it is not a promise of conditions, sightings or value for every traveler.
activities.best_time: Serengeti Balloon Safaris says it operates in multiple regions and discusses flights during both green seasons; morning weather is generally the operating concern, but an individual departure remains conditional. Migration timing varies by year and location. Confirm the launch region and flight status for your exact dates rather than choosing a month on the assumption of a guaranteed herd encounter.
activities.practical_info: Serengeti Balloon Safaris describes an approximately five-hour outing including pre-dawn transfer, briefing, flight, landing breakfast and return. Ask for your camp’s pickup time and launch region; park entry is excluded from the operator’s stated flight price and may or may not already be in your safari package. Weather affects departures. Verify current age, mobility and passenger policies, cancellation terms, price and meeting arrangements directly.

activities.listing_summary: A Maun-based full-day outing combines a 4WD transfer, poler-guided mokoro journey and walk; confirm the launch area, water conditions, included community or park charges and walking requirements.
activities.detail_intro: A mokoro trip trades the reach of a vehicle for a low, quiet passage through Delta waterways. The poler sets the pace and route through channels that are usable at the time, while a guided walk adds a land-based view of the wetland. This is a water-and-walking excursion, not a conventional game drive.
activities.full_description:
Kalahari Breeze Safaris offers a Maun departure that combines a mokoro canoe experience with walking. A typical day of this kind begins with a road transfer from town to a launch area, continues by mokoro with a local poler, then includes time on foot before the return journey. The specific concession, transfer length and sequence must be confirmed with the operator; do not assume the trip reaches a particular island or wildlife area.

What the day feels like in practice

Expect a slower, quieter outing than a vehicle safari. From a low seat, the view follows water level, reeds and channel edges, and movement depends on the poler’s knowledge and current water routes. The walking portion takes place under a guide’s direction and can involve uneven, exposed ground. Wildlife may be present, but sightings are never guaranteed and a mokoro is not an appropriate way to approach large animals.

Ask where the trip launches and how much time is spent driving, poling and walking. Clarify whether the vehicle collects you from your accommodation in Maun, the departure time, food and drinking water, community or concession fees, and whether there is a toilet stop. If you prefer a longer immersion, compare a day trip with an overnight Delta camp; they are different products and should not be conflated.

Water, weather and suitability

Water levels and accessible channels vary, so the route and character can change. Confirm that the operator expects the excursion to run on your date and ask what happens if water or weather conditions make the planned route unsuitable. A mokoro day is a strong fit for travelers comfortable sitting low in an open craft, taking sun exposure and walking in warm conditions. It is less suitable for anyone who needs a vehicle-based day, has difficulty boarding a low canoe, or expects a high-volume wildlife drive; discuss mobility needs with the operator before booking.

What recent guests say

Motolani from France wrote on GetYourGuide on 30 September 2026 that pickup and drop-off were smooth and the mokoro ride peaceful, while describing wildlife sightings as incidental. The outing is centered on the Delta experience, not guaranteed animal encounters.

Pack carefully and respect the place

  • Sun hat, sunscreen, light long sleeves and water in a small bag that can be kept dry.
  • Closed or secure walking footwear suited to the operator’s advice and ground conditions.
  • Binoculars, a camera strap and a dry pouch for phone and essential documents.
  • Any personal medication, plus a light rain layer when the forecast warrants it.

Use the guide’s instructions when wildlife is nearby, keep hands and objects inside the craft, and do not reach for plants or animals. Ask before photographing the poler or other community members. A mokoro has deep cultural roots in the Delta; refer to the local poler as a skilled professional, and do not treat people or their work as scenery.

For the wider wetland context, see the Okavango Delta guide.
activities.best_time: Mokoro routes depend on water and local operating conditions rather than a fixed calendar promise. Confirm current water access, launch location and any route changes with the Maun operator for your travel dates. A seasonal high-water period in one part of the Delta does not establish conditions at every launch point.
activities.practical_info: Kalahari Breeze Safaris operates this full-day Maun excursion combining mokoro and walking. Confirm your pickup or meeting point, drive duration, departure time, exact launch area, food and water, community/concession or park charges, walking expectations, canoe capacity and weather/water cancellation terms. This is not a vehicle game-drive package. Ask about mobility and safe boarding before booking.

activities.name: Cape Coast, Elmina and Kakum guided visit
activities.listing_summary: An Accra day tour links two historic coastal castles with Kakum’s rainforest canopy walkway; check the sequence, entrance tickets, time at each site and long return drive before booking.
activities.detail_intro: This is a demanding full-day circuit with two distinct kinds of attention: the difficult history interpreted at Cape Coast and Elmina castles, and the forest environment at Kakum. The long drive from Accra makes it essential to know how much time the tour actually allows at each stop.
activities.full_description:
The GetYourGuide day tour by Expedition-Go Tours departs Accra and combines Cape Coast Castle, Elmina Castle and Kakum. It links places that deserve more time than a checklist stop: the castles are sites of the transatlantic slave trade, and Kakum is a rainforest park whose suspended canopy walkway is only one part of the landscape. Read the Cape Coast and Kakum guide for regional context before deciding whether to do all three in one day.

A considered sequence

Confirm the actual stop order and departure time. A sensible day gives the castles separate guided visits, with room for interpretation and reflection, then allocates a defined block to Kakum and its visitor facilities before the return drive. The itinerary is road-intensive, so ask how long you spend at each site and whether traffic or queues could shorten the visits. If history is your main reason for coming, consider staying locally and dividing the castles and forest across two days rather than compressing them.

At the castles, listen to the guides and allow the subject to be treated with care. These are not simply picturesque colonial buildings; their interpretation concerns confinement, forced departure and human suffering. Avoid treating memorial spaces as casual photo backdrops, and follow site rules. A guided visit is an opportunity to learn, not a performance or reenactment.

Kakum and the canopy walkway

The Ghana Heritage Conservation Trust describes the canopy walkway as a series of suspended bridges and platforms high above the forest. The experience involves height, narrow suspended sections and walking; travelers uncomfortable with heights should ask whether trails or other visitor options are available rather than feeling obliged to cross. Confirm current opening, ticketing, safety instructions and any guide requirement directly. Rain can affect outdoor comfort and footing, so follow staff directions and wear secure shoes.

Booking and practical trade-offs

For the GetYourGuide tour, confirm which admissions and stops are included in the option you select. Ask whether castle and Kakum fees, lunch, drinking water, guide services and hotel pickup are covered, and whether the return transfer is to the same Accra address. It is a long day for young children and anyone sensitive to road travel. If you need step-free access or have mobility concerns, contact the operator and sites directly; the walkway and historic buildings may not suit every visitor.

  • Comfortable walking shoes with grip, plus a light rain layer.
  • Water and sun protection for transfers and outdoor waiting.
  • A compact bag and any needed medication for a long day away from your base.
  • Camera only where respectful and allowed; ask before photographing guides or other visitors.

Support local interpretation and crafts through authorized site channels, and give the castle visits the seriousness they require.

When comparing departures, look for recent feedback about this exact itinerary, including pacing, additional charges and how the operator handles changes. Reviews of another tour do not establish the experience you are booking.
activities.best_time: Kakum is an outdoor rainforest experience, so rain and humidity can affect comfort and walkway conditions at any time. This Accra day tour also depends on road traffic, opening hours and admissions. Check the current status of all three sites and the operator’s sequence shortly before travel; no season guarantees a clear canopy view or uncrowded visit.
activities.practical_info: The GetYourGuide full-day Accra option names Cape Coast Castle, Elmina Castle and Kakum. Ask which admissions, transport, guide, meals, water and pickup are covered, and verify Kakum walkway operation, height-related suitability and return drop-off. The drive is long; a local overnight stay can make the visits less rushed.

activities.name: Guided Victoria Falls walk from both sides
activities.listing_summary: A guided cross-border visit compares Zimbabwe and Zambia viewpoints; plan for separate park entries, passport and immigration checks, a long exposed walk and current visa eligibility.
activities.detail_intro: Walking the falls with a guide turns a sequence of viewpoints into a comparison of two national parks and two approaches to the Zambezi. The cross-border format adds logistics as well as scenery: each traveler needs the right entry documents, and the tour’s park-fee and transfer inclusions must be checked separately.
activities.full_description:
Cuckoo Safaris’ GetYourGuide option visits both Zimbabwe and Zambia. It is not the simplest choice for every visitor: a one-side walk can be a complete experience, while a two-country circuit brings distinct viewpoints and a border crossing. Start with the Victoria Falls guide, then decide whether both sides matter enough to justify the extra formalities and walking.

How to plan the day

Before booking, confirm the pickup country and location, order of the parks, walking distance, expected total duration, and where the guide meets you after immigration. Carry the passport used for the trip and verify visa or re-entry eligibility for your nationality and route with both countries’ official immigration sources. A visa or entry permission for one country does not automatically authorize entry to the other. If you have a tight onward connection, choose a one-side visit or add generous buffer time.

Allow separate time for park entry and the guide’s interpretation. Water flow, spray and visibility change by season and viewpoint; a guide can explain the landscape but cannot promise a particular panorama. Verify current charges for both parks and determine whether any are included in your selected tour; older published fee tables may no longer apply.

Who benefits from visiting both sides?

It suits travelers who value comparing the viewpoints and have time, documents and mobility for the crossing. It can be tiring for those with limited walking capacity, small children, tight schedules or discomfort with wet paths. Ask the operator about accessible alternatives, pace and rest stops. This guide refers to the currently listed both-sides product; if your passport or schedule makes crossing unsuitable, book a single-side guided walk instead.

What recent guests say

GetYourGuide reviewer Samantha from South Africa (30 September 2026) said fatigue meant she did not complete the Zambia portion, despite her guide accommodating her pace. That is a practical reminder to consider the full walk and border crossing against your stamina.

Pack for spray and borders

  • Passport and any required visas, kept secure but ready for border checks.
  • Walking shoes with grip; paths can be wet or uneven.
  • Light rain layer or poncho, and a small waterproof pouch for phone and camera.
  • Sun protection, drinking water and a light day bag; confirm what park rules allow.

Stay on signed routes, heed barriers and listen to park staff. Ask before photographing guides or other visitors. Treat local place names and explanations with care, and avoid climbing or stepping beyond designated viewpoints for a picture. If a weather or water condition closes part of the route, accept the change rather than seeking an unofficial path.

For additional planning around the border and seasonal differences, see our Victoria Falls first-visit plan.
activities.best_time: The look and feel of the falls changes with Zambezi water levels: heavier spray can reduce visibility while lower water can expose more rock and alter viewpoints. The cross-border walk itself depends on park operations and border formalities. Check the current park status, weather, fee schedule and entry requirements for your exact date; a seasonal description is not a guarantee of conditions.
activities.practical_info: Cuckoo Safaris’ GetYourGuide tour crosses between Zimbabwe and Zambia. Confirm pickup side, transfers, guide, duration, stops, separate park fees, cancellation terms and meeting points after border checks. Carry a passport and verify entry and re-entry requirements for each traveller’s nationality and route: Zambia Immigration KAZA Univisa eligibility and authorized ports and Zimbabwe Immigration visa information (both checked 24 October 2026). Rules depend on nationality and itinerary; verify directly before booking. Zambia Tourism labels its published park-fee schedule as 2025 and subject to change, so confirm current fees for both parks. Wear grippy walking shoes and bring a rain layer, waterproof pouch, water and sun protection. Follow designated routes and park-staff instructions.

activities.detail_intro: Rafting below Victoria Falls is a full-body river day: Batoka Gorge access, safety preparation and the climb back out are part of the challenge, alongside the rapids themselves. Choose it for the river experience and physical commitment, not as a casual add-on between short sightseeing stops.
activities.listing_summary: A Wild Horizons full-day trip runs through Batoka Gorge with steep gorge access; confirm river-level operation, age and fitness eligibility, town pickup, excluded park charges and insurance before booking.
activities.full_description:
Below Victoria Falls, the Zambezi cuts through Batoka Gorge. Wild Horizons describes this guided trip as Class V rafting and publishes a 7.5-hour day that includes town transfers, equipment, lunch, river time and steep walking into and out of the gorge. The descent and return climb are significant parts of the effort, so assess the whole day rather than judging suitability from the boat portion alone.

A full river day

Expect to travel from Victoria Falls Town, receive the operator’s briefing and gear, descend to the river, raft with the guides, take the included lunch and climb back to the vehicle before returning to town. Confirm the exact sequence, start time and meeting point with Wild Horizons, especially if you are staying outside town. The 7.5-hour published duration is a planning estimate; allow the day to remain free.

River season and eligibility

Wild Horizons says rafting operation depends on water levels and publishes seasonal guidance. Its stated months are not a guarantee that a trip will run on your date: ask the operator about current river levels, route and cancellation options. The operator lists a minimum age of 15, with younger participants only at management discretion, and asks for reasonable fitness. Confirm current health, swimming, age and weight rules directly, including whether the gorge access suits you.

Costs, transfers and insurance

The operator lists rafting gear, guides, lunch and transfers from Victoria Falls Town as included. It excludes pickup outside town and the Parks River Usage fee; confirm current charges, payment method and whether any other fees apply. Its terms require personal travel insurance covering emergency evacuation, medical costs and repatriation, and ask guests to reconfirm at the town office on arrival day. Check that your insurer covers white-water rafting at the relevant grade and any evacuation arrangements.

When comparing departures, look for recent feedback about this exact itinerary, including pacing, additional charges and how the operator handles changes. Reviews of another tour do not establish the experience you are booking.

What to wear and carry

  • Swimwear under shorts and a sun-protective shirt.
  • Secure trainers or rafting shoes; the operator advises against flip-flops.
  • A cap that fits under the helmet, with eyeglasses secured by a strap.
  • Sunscreen and lip balm; ask about seasonal wetsuit provision.
  • Leave valuables behind and carry only what the operator permits.

Follow the guide and safety crew immediately, including instructions on where to sit, how to hold the paddle and what to do after a capsize. Do not enter the gorge or river independently. If you are not confident about the physical demands, ask direct questions before paying; a scenic river cruise is a gentler alternative.

Use the Victoria Falls guide for park and viewpoint planning. The site’s Victoria Falls Hotel guide covers one town base; confirm pickup with the operator rather than assuming the hotel is a designated stop.
activities.best_time: Wild Horizons describes rafting as seasonal and dependent on water levels; its guide lists low-water rafting broadly from July into early December. Conditions and operating decisions vary, and that window does not guarantee a departure or a particular rapid. Confirm current operation, river conditions and route with the operator for your exact date.
activities.practical_info: Wild Horizons publishes a 7.5-hour trip, minimum age 15 (younger only at management discretion), reasonable fitness, steep gorge access, equipment, lunch, guides and Victoria Falls Town transfers. It excludes transfers from properties outside town and the Parks River Usage fee; reconfirm current charges. Reconfirm at the operator’s town office on arrival day. Its terms require insurance for emergency evacuation, medical and repatriation expenses; ensure your policy covers rafting.
